notes: General changes: --added transformed log feedback for Transcendence Dice and Solar Dice --added skill visuals for Drizzle Dice --improved visual effect on Electric Dice

Bug fixes: --fixed an issue that caused a die's active skill to gain mana if the die has no way to attack during its turn --fixed Druid Dice's passive healing not being boostable by damage multipliers --fixed Transcendence beam targeting against backline infiltrators --fixed clunky Transcendence beam visual geometry --fixed both of Growth Dice growth visuals --fixed an issue that caused inconsistent transformed dice states --fixed the history log so it doesn't stutter while combat is initiated --stability fixes regarding transformation states
Casino: --Added table info renders to check how each table rewards you based on specific dice rolls --Diamonds can now be obtained from chests with a certain probability range (depending on type)
Dice Catalogue: --Equipping a die on your loadout is now much easier — select the slot you want to put it on! --Added a new setting that enables the old-fashioned slot equip as before

Challenge improvements: --Deucifer's Challenge: Boss phase turn limit exceeded from 15 -> 20 --Deucifer's Challenge: Boss phase now commences at the final turn even when all minions are not fully defeated
Bosses: --Added boss-specific music during boss fights

Dice balance: --Iron: Fixed unintended interaction where its proportional current HP damage would scale with damage multipliers --Solitude: Fixed unintended interaction where its proportional max HP damage would scale with damage multipliers

Bug fixes: --fixed incorrect visual targeting for certain abilities --fixed Druid Dice's Uncontrollable Maul skill damage not being scalable with class --fixed Druid Dice not having a view-form modal --fixed crit-specific skills performing worse than intended
Dice additions: Drizzle, Druid and Armor.
Boss additions: Basilisk.
Shop changes: Dice copy offers can now be purchased with Dice Tokens if applicable.
Gameplay improvements: All direct-damaging attacks and abilities have a 5% chance to cause double damage onto hit targets (affects healing)

Dice balance: --Poison: Poison damage increased from 20 -> 25 --Gamble: Health reduced from 560 -> 540 --Broken: Damage increased from 32 -> 34 --Iron: Health reduced from 800 -> 760 --Slingshot: Health reduced from 560 -> 480 --Broken Growth: Health increased from 680 -> 700 --Broken Growth: Damage increased from 24 -> 28 --Growth: Damage increased from 24 -> 26 --Solar: Heatwave damage increased from 100% -> 125%

Bug fixes: --fixed a bug that caused weird dice definition loading behaviour --fixed achievement listing UI being janky --fixed incorrect board-side active skill targeting for infiltrated foes --stability fixes
Dice additions: Solar, Slingshot and Lock.
Dice Card: added Vanguard and Centerline dice cards.
Refactored dice descriptions and class-up handling to bolster consistency
Refactored skill and runtime metadata handling to futureproof the game from stale edge cases
Added active status effect view in the dice info panel in arena

Dice balance: --Ice: Slow can now stack up to 3 times on the same target --Deucifer: Damage increased from 60 -> 80 --Deucifer: Raise From Hell mana charge rate reduced from 15 -> 14 --Leon: Attack range reduced from 5 -> 4 --Leon: Furious Claw stun duration increased from 1 turn -> 2 turns
Fixed a bug related to freebie shop offers for endgame progression
Dice additions: Soul and Broken Growth.
Dice Card: added Crowd Attack and Fire Support cards.
Casino: added a Fives gauge bar that guarantees a Five-of-a-kind when it's full in Fives tables.
Improved certain dice descriptions to be more clearer and comprehensive.

Dice balance: --Wind: Damage increased from 20 -> 22 --Shield: Damage reduced from 18 -> 16 --Iron: Proportional damage reduced from 15% -> 14% --Iron: Proportional damage increase per Class UP reduced from 0.5% -> 0.4% --Skull: Range reduced from 3 -> 2 --Skull: Damage increased from 16 -> 22 --Solitude: Max HP damage increase per Class UP reduced from 0.25% -> 0.2%
Fixed a bug related to freebie shop offers for endgame progression
New bosses: Magician and Leon, each with class-level scaling skills and a 3rd skill unlocked at Boss Level 6.
New challenge: Dopamine Challenge, a Dice Card random-mode gauntlet.
New achievements: Magical Cycle, Boss Slayer, Boss Ripper, Boss Hunter, Hooked and Stacked Up.
Dice Card: type upgrade icons are now dicelike and coloured by their rarity (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Dice info panel now lists active Dice Card buffs (Spotlight, Investments, etc.) and Combanity roll details.
Giant Hunter Dice Card now inflicts only 50% of its bonus damage against bosses.
Bosses now summon minions 5 class levels lower (min. Class 1) than the parent; minions now scale like general dice while bosses keep their own exceptions.
Dice descriptions now react to class levels, and Transcendence/boss skill text was clarified.
Fixed newly-spawned minions hanging the return-to-sender process during battle.
Fixed Transcendence Dice 6-pip form not having grid-wide (infinite) range.
Several fixes and improvements
Beta release of Battle Dice.
